claim_boundary.allowed_if_primary_positive: At fixed per-task pair budgets, on a temporally later identity-closed MLE-agent cohort, the predeclared broad-support curation rule outperforms the predeclared concentrated-support rule for this fixed cheap critic on official-five-decimal raw-grade sibling ranking accuracy.
claim_boundary.random_arm_role: descriptive sanity baseline only; random cannot rescue broad-versus-concentrated

cohort.prediction_population: all unordered pairs induced by every nonempty-parent endpoint in each hash-bound eligible_blind_manifest of the target-300 closed identity cohort (including complete boundary-archive overshoot); manifest endpoint totals must equal the pre-outcome intake inventory and every cohort run endpoint ledger, and evaluation later restricts to the already-frozen score-channel selected-parent receipt without reselection

faithful_normalized_secondary.pair_population: within the exact selected-parent population, pairs with both y_norm values available and absolute y_norm difference greater than 1e-12
faithful_normalized_secondary.role: descriptive normalized-label sensitivity only; a positive result is not a second confirmatory claim or a replication claim

inference_order: average the three predeclared selection seeds
evaluation_after_truth_open.log_loss_definition: on the same official-grade raw non-tied pairs, p(left better)=sigmoid(margin_left_minus_right), binary cross-entropy is averaged pair within parent, parent within task, then across the three nuisance seeds and tasks
evaluation_after_truth_open.log_loss_role: secondary calibration diagnostic only; cannot rescue primary accuracy
evaluation_after_truth_open.parent_population: exact outcome-available selected_parents.jsonl produced by the frozen score-channel dual-truth finite-grade-availability plus SHA-256 lottery; no post-label or post-prediction reselection and no extrapolation to all structural siblings
evaluation_after_truth_open.primary_estimand: Task-macro parent-macro pair accuracy of broad minus concentrated, after averaging three frozen nuisance selection seeds, on official-five-decimal raw-grade non-tied sibling pairs in the fixed selected-parent population; raw-truth-tied pairs are excluded and an exact zero prediction margin receives 0.5 credit.
evaluation_after_truth_open.primary_truth: official-five-decimal raw graded; truth ties are absolute difference <=1e-12 and are excluded
evaluation_after_truth_open.task_inclusion: every task with at least one raw-nontied contributing selected parent enters with equal task weight; per-task contributing-parent counts must be reported
evaluation_after_truth_open.task_minimum_role: minimum analyzability and breadth floor, not a power guarantee

prediction_escrow.artifact_replication: producer x2 byte-identical plus independent source-refit verifier x2

arms.broad: Within each task, take one orientation-independent hash-ranked pair from every component up to the target, then hash-fill remaining pairs.
arms.concentrated: Within each task, order components by descending pair count with hash tie-breaks, then take pairs until the exact target.
arms.random: Within each task, take the orientation-independent hash prefix of all pairs to the exact target.

selection.target_pairs_per_task: ceil(0.5 * available component-clean train pairs for task)

stop_rules: Refuse unless the fixed one-time first-closure anchor binds the target-300 identity cohort (including complete boundary-archive overshoot) and its summary says truth unread; callers cannot supply an alternate cohort path or digest.
Write all endpoint scores and pair selections before any label vault may be opened.
Do not change arms, seeds, pair budget, model, parent population, truth precision, support gates, bootstrap, effect floor, or claim after any future truth is read.
If the primary support gate fails, report insufficient support and do not compute or characterize a primary effect.
A normalized, log-loss, random-arm, task-subgroup, or alternate-threshold result cannot rescue a failed raw-grade primary.
